description: EXPLORATORY census of QOU knot/link operators: writhe (U(1)_framing), Markov-stabilization scaling (B_n->B_{n+1} bridge), Hopf n-independence. All RAW @ 60 dps; no tuning to any observable.
caveats: Markov de-stabilization H_5 -> H_3 is only valid when the removed strands are DISJOINT from the closure (Markov axiom 3). The Borromean braid (s1^-1 s2)^3 uses BOTH generators of B_3 non-trivially and is Brunnian (every 2-sublink is trivial) -- so a strand cannot be removed without changing the link type. Therefore plain Markov de-stabilization does NOT give a derived H_5(fiber) -> H_3(Borromean) functor. The 5-strand fiber object and the 3-strand trace remain in different rep rings. The bridge is OPEN: a derived map requires either (a) a cabling/satellite operation (2-cabling a 3-strand pattern -> 6 strands, NOT 5), or (b) an explicit branching functor Res^{H_5}_{H_3} composed with the fiber decoration -- neither is supplied by the current framework. No fit attempted.

U(1)_framing, STATED PER LEVEL (the writhe is a property of the braid word, not of its closure: Markov-I invariant, but Markov-II stabilization shifts it by +-1 while presenting the same link, so a level must be named). AT LEVEL n=2 (B_2): writhe is nonzero (+2m) for the torus knots T(2,2m), including the Hopf sigma_1^2 (w=+2), and for every T(2,odd) lepton carrier. AT LEVEL n=3 (B_3): writhe is ZERO for the Borromean baryon and for the figure-eight, and nonzero for T(3,4) (w=+8) and T(3,5) (w=+10). So a nonzero-writhe operator (e.g. a T(2,2m) color-tube operator) WOULD carry a nontrivial U(1)_framing phase q^{w.c} AT ITS OWN LEVEL. This is a RAW structural observation; mapping writhe -> hypercharge Y is NOT derived and is NOT attempted. The production nucleon uses the writhe-0 Borromean at n=3, so the framing U(1) is trivial there -- consistent with the s5-so3 audit. Under the owner ruling (states are Groebner-Shirshov normal forms; the observable is the trace at the lowest level of the tower, the braid index) these canonical words ARE the states, so the census compares states and the per-level readings above stand as written.

LEVEL-INDEPENDENT COMPANION: writhe_minus_level_parity = (w - n) mod 2 is emitted per row, computed from the stored (writhe, strands_B_n) pair. It is the COMPLETE invariant of the Markov-II action (w, n) -> (w +- 1, n + 1) (QOU/StandardModel/WritheLevelParity.lean: markovPair_parity soundness, markovPair_of_even completeness) and equals the component parity of the closure. In this census only the Hopf link comes out EVEN (0): it is the one 2-component closure; every other operator here is odd (1). It carries exactly ONE BIT and therefore cannot substitute for a magnitude, for Q = w/2, or for I_3; its fermion/boson reading is separately REFUTED (the gluon unit sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1} closes to a single component, hence odd, yet is a boson). Use it ONLY as a consistency check on level-crossing claims. NOT wired. Ref: docs/audits/2026-08-10-writhe-level-of-definition.md.
